title: Anagama Kiln Firing—Fall 2026
source_quote: Join us for our Anagama Kiln Firing this Fall. Ceramicists will start glazing and loading on Friday, October 9 at 9am. Firing will begin that evening and continue through Sunday afternoon, October 11.
